critique.evidence: Keyboard coverage and visible focus passed for every expected Arena control at all viewports; no touch-target violations or uncontained viewport overflow were measured, and reduced-motion sampling found zero changed elements. However, WCAG contrast remains unproven: axe returned serious incomplete color-contrast checks for 10 chart labels at tablet/mobile and 27 Arena nodes at desktop, plus 12 header links on mobile and one on tablet. The mobile/tablet header also clips off-screen navigation inside a horizontal scroller; it is contained, but no touch/scroll discoverability evidence was supplied.
critique.fix: Measure computed contrast manually for every unresolved SVG label, React Flow node, and header link against its actual composited background, then raise failing colors to WCAG AA. Add and test an explicit accessible label and visible affordance for the horizontally scrollable header navigation, including touch, keyboard, and screen-reader operation.
